scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @arnifi/contracts && npm run build --workspace @arnifi/functions && npm run build --workspace @arnifi/phone-bell-worker && npm run build --workspace @arnifi/web
scripts.build:dev: npm run build --workspace @arnifi/contracts && npm run build --workspace @arnifi/functions && npm run build --workspace @arnifi/phone-bell-worker && npm run build:dev --workspace @arnifi/web
scripts.build:prod: npm run build --workspace @arnifi/contracts && npm run build --workspace @arnifi/functions && npm run build --workspace @arnifi/phone-bell-worker && npm run build:prod --workspace @arnifi/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @arnifi/contracts --if-present && npm run test --workspace @arnifi/functions && npm run test --workspace @arnifi/phone-bell-worker && npm run test --workspace @arnifi/web
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-arnifi-phone-bell "npm run test:rules --workspace @arnifi/functions"
scripts.deploy:firebase:dev: firebase use dev && npm run build:dev && firebase deploy --only firestore,hosting
scripts.deploy:firebase:prod: firebase use prod && npm run build:prod && firebase deploy --only firestore,hosting
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run deploy:worker:dev && npm run deploy:firebase:dev
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run deploy:worker:prod && npm run deploy:firebase:prod
